headline: Bitcoin Drops Below $76,000 as Altcoins Face Sharp Weekly Losses
summary: Bitcoin traded flat near $75,944 after sliding more than 5% earlier in the week, while Solana, XRP, and Ether touched multi-month lows. Total cryptocurrency market valuation shrank to $2.56 trillion.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, serving as a liquidity sentiment gauge for digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Widespread risk aversion across global risk assets pulled crypto capitalization down 7% over seven days.
